title: Viral Raspberry Dark-Choc Coconut Clusters
hookLine: Juicy fresh raspberries folded in creamy Greek yogurt, frozen, and dipped in crisp 80% dark chocolate!

items.name: Fresh raspberries + 1/2 cup Greek or coconut yogurt
Melted 80% dark chocolate + 1 tsp coconut oil

steps.title: Line Freezer Tray & Prep Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Line a rimmed baking sheet or loaf pan with parchment paper so your frozen treat lifts out cleanly. Measure out {rc_ber} and keep toppings like {rc_chc} prepped within reach.

steps.title: Dollop Berry Yogurt & Dip in Dark Choc
steps.instructionTemplate: Toss {rc_ber} gently, scoop 8 clusters onto parchment, freeze 30 mins, then coat in {rc_chc} and chill 5 mins to snap. Gently press the coating onto every side so it adheres evenly, then let excess drip off before transferring to a clean tray.
steps.creatorSecret: A teaspoon of coconut oil gives the dark chocolate a thin, satisfyingly snappy shell.

steps.title: Transfer, Smooth Top & Add Garnish
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour or press the mixture evenly into your prepared dish, smoothing the surface with a spatula. Scatter {rc_chc} evenly across the top and press gently so it adheres cleanly.

steps.title: Freeze Solid, Portion & Enjoy
steps.instructionTemplate: Freeze Viral Raspberry Dark-Choc Coconut Clusters flat until completely solid, then let sit 3 minutes at room temperature before slicing, snapping, or scooping into 8 servings. Store leftovers in a freezer-safe container.

ugcQuotes.quote: Zero refined sugar and only 140 cal—tastes like total indulgence!
